allow: PowerShell(try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:6006/index.json" -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 5; $j = $r.Content | ConvertFrom-Json; Write-Output \("Stories count: " + \($j.entries.PSObject.Properties.Count\)\) } catch { Write-Output "ERROR: $_" })

PowerShell(try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:6006/index.json" -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 10; $j = $r.Content | ConvertFrom-Json; $count = $j.entries.PSObject.Properties.Count; $titles = $j.entries.PSObject.Properties | ForEach-Object { $_.Value.title } | Sort-Object -Unique; Write-Output "Status: $\($r.StatusCode\)"; Write-Output "Entries: $count"; Write-Output "Titles: $\($titles.Count\)" } catch { Write-Output "ERROR: $_" })

PowerShell(try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:6006/" -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 10; Write-Output "Manager status: $\($r.StatusCode\), bytes: $\($r.RawContentLength\)" } catch { Write-Output "ERROR: $_" })

PowerShell(try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:6006/iframe.html?id=primitives-button--variants&viewMode=story" -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 10; Write-Output "Iframe status: $\($r.StatusCode\), bytes: $\($r.RawContentLength\)" } catch { Write-Output "ERROR: $_" })
